name: control-m1-chosen
keys: +wait Video: no renderer can draw a transparent window (
expect: ^Video: recreating the window for a transparent background$
^Reload: done at 1920x1079 px, for .*a new window$
^Test hook: the Mode row's cursor rested on Transparent$
absent: ^Test hook: the Mode row's cursor rested on Slideshow$

name: m1-old-form
keys: +wait Video: no renderer can draw a transparent window (
expect: ^Video: recreating the window for a transparent background$
^Reload: done at 1920x1079 px, for .*a new window$
^Test hook: the Mode row's cursor rested on Transparent$
absent: ^Test hook: the Mode row's cursor rested on Slideshow$

name: control-m2-picker
keys: +wait Settings: opened the picker for [Background] ChromaKeyColor
expect: ^Settings: the cursor left Mode before it rested, so the window keeps its kind for now$
^Settings: opened the picker for \[Background\] ChromaKeyColor$

name: m2-rest-kept
keys: +wait Settings: opened the picker for [Background] ChromaKeyColor
expect: ^Settings: opened the picker for \[Background\] ChromaKeyColor$

name: control-m3-own
keys: +wait Test hook: pushed a mode change of the window's display
expect: pushed a mode change of the window's display\n(?:.*\n)*Video: fitting the transparent window to display [0-9]+, 1920x1079 at 0,0$

name: control-m3-other
keys: +wait Test hook: pushed a mode change of another display
absent: pushed a mode change of another display\n(?:.*\n)*Video: fitting

name: m3-old-form
keys: +wait Test hook: pushed a mode change of another display
absent: pushed a mode change of another display\n(?:.*\n)*Video: fitting

name: control-cap
keys: +wait Reload: done at 1920x1079 px, for a device reset or loss
expect: ^Renderer: device lost and not recovered, 3 times on this transparent window; an opaque window takes its place$
^Video: no renderer can draw a transparent window \(the renderer was lost 3 times on this window\); using an opaque background$
^Reload: done at 1920x1080 px, for .*a new window$

name: cap-off-by-one
keys: +wait Reload: done at 1920x1079 px, for a device reset or loss
expect: ^Video: no renderer can draw a transparent window \(the renderer was lost 3 times on this window\); using an opaque background$
^Reload: done at 1920x1080 px, for .*a new window$

name: cap-retry-unchecked
keys: +wait Reload: done at 1920x1079 px, for a device reset or loss
expect: ^Video: no renderer can draw a transparent window \(the renderer was lost 3 times on this window\); using an opaque background$
^Reload: done at 1920x1080 px, for .*a new window$

name: cap-count-not-kept
keys: +wait Reload: done at 1920x1079 px, for a device reset or loss
expect: ^Video: no renderer can draw a transparent window \(the renderer was lost 3 times on this window\); using an opaque background$
^Reload: done at 1920x1080 px, for .*a new window$

name: control-cap-opaque
keys: +wait Reload: done at 1920x1080 px, for a device reset or loss
expect: (?:^Renderer: creating a new renderer, attempt 1 of 5$[\s\S]*){3}
